pages.text: The Beenergy Generator is a simple yet effective way to generate Forging Energy (FE). It burns bee-related products to produce power for your other machines, like the $(l:beeindustry:machines/sap_press)Sap Press$().$(br2)It's an essential first step into the energy management of Bee Industry.

pages.title: Operation
pages.text: Simply place a valid fuel source, such as $(l:beeindustry:items/fuel)Sweet Honey$() or even simple Coal, into the fuel slot. The generator will start burning it to produce energy. $(br2)You can extract the energy from any side using Cables or other compatible energy pipes.
